target.public_label: Modelled estimate — county-constrained agricultural spatial allocation

rationale: KDA has official KNBS 2024 Agriculture GVA for all 47 counties but no defensible current constituency/ward values. The World Bank AgGDP raster has passed the predeclared spatial-prior feasibility gate against KNBS county Agriculture GVA (Spearman > 0.60) and supplies an independent agricultural economic-activity surface. It is used only to distribute each official county control within that county.

central_spatial_surface.source: World Bank Global Gridded Agricultural Gross Domestic Product (AgGDP)

method.central: For each level independently, exact-fractionally sum AgGDP raster values in each child polygon, normalize child weights within the canonical KDA county, and multiply by official KNBS 2024 county Agriculture GVA.
method.sensitivity: Construct an alternative raw prior surface by summing crop, livestock, fish and forest prior values at each child polygon, normalize within county, and allocate the same official county Agriculture GVA.
method.rounding: Allocate in KES million to 2 decimals using largest-remainder cents so child values reconcile exactly to the official county control.

predeclared_publication_gate.cell_rule: A candidate is promotion-eligible only when both central AgGDP and summed component-prior allocations are positive and absolute central-vs-sensitivity spread divided by their mean is <= 50%. Failing cells remain governed unavailable; the threshold is frozen before candidate execution.

uncertainty.lower: minimum of the two county-constrained allocations
uncertainty.upper: maximum of the two county-constrained allocations
uncertainty.caveat: Not a statistical confidence interval. It measures sensitivity to the optimized AgGDP surface versus the raw sum of its four sectoral priors.
